Title: Insertion Sort
Description: Builds the final sorted array one item at a time by repeatedly taking the next element and inserting it into the correct position among the already-sorted elements.
Explanation: Insertion sort works similarly to the way you sort playing cards in your hands. You pick one card at a time and insert it into its correct position relative to the cards you already hold.
